title: A Lanternfall language
description: content/lang/<code>.json, or a mod's lang/<code>.json. Start from content/lang/template.json.

name.description: The language's own name, as Settings shows it: Español, Français, 日本語.

strings.description: English line → translation. {0}, {1}, … are values (names, numbers) and must all be kept, in any order. An empty or missing translation keeps the English. A key starting with // is a comment.
